title: 2026 Q4 Outlook
summary: The energy shock keeps inflation sticky. I expect the Fed and ECB to hike in December, favour the USD over the EUR, and position through gold, equal-weight US equities, US energy, IG over HY and 5-year breakevens.
body:
Macro outlook by Chua Ming Yuan, dated 27 Oct 2026, before the October FOMC and ECB meetings. The full note and charts are in the attached PDF.

## Central bank paths

| Bank | Call | Reasoning |
|---|---|---|
| Fed | Hold 28 Oct at 3.75% to 4.00%. 25bp hike 8 to 9 Dec, 25bp hike Jan 2027 to 4.25% to 4.50%, then pause | Energy shock passing through to core. December is largely priced, so limited value in expressing that view |
| ECB | Hold 29 Oct at 2.50%. 25bp hike 17 Dec, deposit rate peaks at 2.75% | Less tightening than the three more hikes markets price by Sep 2027, as financial conditions and French spreads do part of the work |

## Regional views

- **US rates:** yields are attractive, but a sustained rally needs lower energy prices or slower growth.
- **USD:** asymmetric upside. Tailwinds from a Fed hiking cycle, and lower energy would not drive significant weakness.
- **US growth:** resilient near term, slowing to below trend in H1 2027 as real wages fall.
- **US inflation:** sticky and elevated over the next 12 months as oil prices stay high.
- **Euro area rates:** expect the OAT-Bund spread to keep widening from 150.8bp, with S&P's 27 Nov review and the November budget votes as catalysts.
- **EUR:** bearish, as hikes get priced out while the Fed holds or hikes again, and on energy exposure and French political risk.
- **Euro area inflation:** elevated as the energy shock persists, with pass-through to core building over 12 months.

## Portfolio themes

1. Energy prices stay elevated for longer than markets price.
2. Investors question whether AI spending can generate enough free cash flow.
3. Geopolitical fragmentation keeps central banks buying gold.

## Trades

| Trade | Expression | Core argument |
|---|---|---|
| Long gold | SPDR Gold Shares on SGX (O87). Starter position now, complete after the Jan 2027 FOMC | Central bank buying sets a floor, and gold diversifies the rest of the book |
| Long equal weight | Long RSP, short SPY | Leadership broadens away from AI and semiconductors as earnings growth widens |
| Long US energy equities | XLE | Equities are valued on long-dated oil prices, while producers earn today's spot prices |
| Long IG, short HY | Credit spread gap | Higher rates and refinancing squeeze weak borrowers, led by debt-funded AI names |
| Long US 5Y breakevens | Buy 5Y TIPS, sell 5Y nominal Treasuries | At 2.39%, the market prices a fast energy fade |
